{{Quote|I would like to petition for Sector Four of the reclaimed marshlands. I have several promising vegetative species under development.|Plee|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Balance Point">''[[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point]]''</ref>}}
'''Sector Four''' was an administrative division on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duro/Legends|Duro]], during [[Senate Select Committee for Refugees|SELCORE's]] attempt to rehabilitate the planet for habitation during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Two scientists from SELCORE competed over claims to utilize this area, with one wanting to use it for their [[Grain/Legends|grain]] project, while [[Plee]] wanted to use it for his experimental plants.
